mapper.insert: INSERT INTO release_run_summary (plan_id, run_seq, total_ms, step_detail, started_at, finished_at, operator) VALUES (#{planId}, #{runSeq}, #{totalMs}, CAST(#{stepDetail,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{operator}) ON CONFLICT (plan_id, run_seq) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM release_run_summary WHERE plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY run_seq
